note: Structured companion to ROBOT_INFERENCE_RULES.md. Human-readable rules that govern the parse -> derive -> match workflow. Status: implemented | partial | planned.

rules.then: manipulation-morphology evidence (does not override sibling/off-subject gate)
food_prep|beverage_prep|serving_task|surface_clean (distinct from generic manipulate / hotel housekeeping / hospital EVS)

rules.rule: do not infer transport from mobility; transport requires claims_item_delivery; tote_transport requires warehouse tote/cart evidence
human-in-the-loop picking (person-to-goods / workers pick) grounds transport, never manipulate

rules.then: bipedal + mobile_base; arm_count=2 when hand/effector present

rules.rule: 2 arms + 2 hands + vision + mobile body => likely mobile-manipulation platform, but payload/reach/autonomy each need their own evidence
AMR != cannot manipulate; grounds manipulate/tote_transport only from its own configuration evidence
humanoid does not auto-grant palletize; needs manipulation + payload/throughput evidence
facts from sibling products may not flow into the selected product
do not infer a capability from company-level copy when the selected product has no supporting hardware
optional modules must be represented as configurations, not universal product capabilities
a job requirement is MATCHED only if the specific required capability is grounded; generic mobile is a gate
any required UNMET => NOT_A_MATCH; unknowns preserved, never guessed; no match percentage

if: product_class in {agriculture, agricultural_robot} | claims_agriculture | LaserWeeder / carbonrobotics.com weeding evidence
rules.then: agriculture_task + mobile (named derivation; empty specs stay UNKNOWN)

if: product_class in {healthcare, medical_robot, clinical_robot, hospital_robot} | claims_healthcare | hospital/clinical work-language (ontology industry_work_language.v1.json)
rules.then: healthcare_task + mobile. A social torso is not a humanoid class. Empty specs stay UNKNOWN.

rules.rule: Work-language / task-model evidence outranks generic humanoid morphology when both fire. Hardware still comes first. Industry work words live in ontology/industry_work_language.v1.json — not a FIND-only deny list. A social torso, face, or arm does not override hospital or hotel delivery work. Warehouse/factory/logistics humanoids stay humanoid (those verticals do not outrank morphology).

rules.then: marine_task + mobile (hull/port/underwater — not a category dump)

if: product_class in {avionics, aviation_robot, drone, evtol} | claims_avionics
rules.then: avionics_task + mobile (drones / eVTOL / autonomous aircraft — not satellites)

evtol_flight (air-taxi). drone/uav → drone_task. autonomous_aircraft → autonomous_flight. Hangar/airside walking requires inspect_route or drone_task, never evtol_flight. Generic avionics class is the flying-work union, not a SKU dump.

rules.rule: if a configuration grounds a domain work primitive (evtol_flight / drone_task / agriculture_task / construction_task / …), jobs must exercise that primitive; never pad leftover slots with CNC/pack/warehouse cobot work

weeding laser ≠ cutting laser. LaserWeeder / FarmDroid / claims_weeding must exercise agriculture_weed; CNC / laser/plasma cutting / pack / cobot machine-tend cannot fill leftover slots. Never keyword-leak 'laser' from LaserWeeder onto shop-floor cutting cells.

rules.then: aerospace_task + mobile (satellites / rockets / orbital debris — not drones)
agriculture_task (DERIVED). An implement is a configuration of hardware on a tractor/combine, not a fake attachment class. Empty specs stay UNKNOWN.
